reviews.t: This facial scrub makes my skin softer than a baby's bottom
reviews.x: My face used to be flakier than my brother Aiden's scalp in the winter time. That is pretty dern flaky if you ask me. I did not want my facial skin to resemble that of a reptile. I used this cleaner once and I just knew it would be in my grooming routine for a long long time. It exfoliates and removes those disgusting flakes and also leave me y skin.I would definitely moisturize after using this though

reviews.t: this is a great and unique facial scrub
reviews.x: This is an awesome and incredible facial scrub.  I use this several times a week before I got to bed. Then I follow it up with moisturizer and I wake up with the softest and more radiant complexion. This has lots of vitamins that are good for the skin, some of which you wouldn't necessarily expect to find in a facial scrub. But that is what makes this facial scrub unique and above the rest

reviews.t: I get tons of compliment with this facial scrub
reviews.x: My face usually behaves itself, but I like to give it a good scrub every so often. I wanted a gentle and effective scrub and that is exactly what this is. It has the perfect abrasive quality to it. Not too much but not too harsh either. This makes my face baby soft and smooth and I actually get TONS of compliments on my skin after I use this. A good scrub will do this, and THIS is a good scrub

reviews.t: My face scrub makes me beautiful
reviews.x: I can't rely only on my amazing genetics to keep my skin clean and beautiful sometimes i need to put in the extra effort which means moisturizing daily as well as washing my face before i go to sleep at night. This face scrub does wonders for my face. It smooths out the creases and gives my skin a visible healthy shine as well as keeps it moisturized!

reviews.t: Lovely
reviews.x: I got this because I have sensitive skin that has been extremely dry and rough this winter.  This gentle exfoliator has helped me rid the rough stuff and not dry out extra.  I use this in combination with an awesome moisturizer, and one week later ZERO rough skin, it's soft and smooth again.

reviews.t: Facial scrub in a elegant tub
reviews.x: Sometimes you want to pamper yourself. Treat yourself to something a little bit more special than what you're used to. I bought this face scrub with that in mind. The package is what sold me and the quality of the scrub is what kept me using it everyday! My skin feels like it's gotten a second life!

reviews.t: Smooth skin with natural facial scrub
reviews.x: I have sensitive skin. I have read that to exfoliate skin gently acids would be better, but I think that sounds scary and I will stick with my facial scrubs, that work well for me, if they are designed for sensitive skin. This on has been gentle and I still get results. Smooth skin.

reviews.t: deep cleaning face scrub
reviews.x: Take it from me this scrub does the job of getting deep into your pores and getting rid of dirt and grime build up that would normally leave your skin oily and pimple prone. I have used a lot of products for my face and i just found a new favorite in this face wash.

reviews.x: This face scrub is going to be on my bathroom counter for a long while. I use it every other day and it keeps my skin super soft and flake free, which is a big issue for me especially this time of year. It doesn't just exfoliate my face, it also has nourishing vitamins and oils that ensure my skin will not stripped and is in fact almost moisturized. I always follow up with a moisturizer but I only need a light one

reviews.t: Nice consistency, good results.

Will order again, although I would prefer it if this came in a tube.  I'd rather not dip my fingers in the pot and risk contaminating the contents.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the scrub leaves their skin soft, smooth, and flake-free.
Reviewers with sensitive skin report the scrub is gentle and effective for them.
Several reviewers praise the scrub for deep cleaning and improving their complexion.
A few reviewers report negative experiences, including breakouts and an unpleasant smell.
Some reviewers found the scrub ineffective or disliked its texture and greasy feel.
